research_period: Milan, Paris and Pitti Uomo menswear shows, June 2026; Premiere Vision Paris, February 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Global: Milan, Paris and Florence runways; premium and mid-market menswear
title: SS27 Men's Woven Fabric Direction
summary: Sheer shirting, satin, seersucker, soft leather and light tailoring wools lead SS27 menswear fabrics, with crease-proof stretch for travel.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- **Sheer shirting:** translucent fabrics from subtle to full transparency, at Kiko Kostadinov, Feng Chen Wang, Dior, Prada, Dries Van Noten, Jacquemus and Saint Laurent<sup>[1]</sup>.
- **Satin:** synthetic and silk satin, floral and white, with a billowing drape, at Willy Chavarria, Celine, GmbH and AMI<sup>[1]</sup>.
- **Silk and gauze tailoring:** fluid, almost sheer suits at Dior<sup>[2]</sup>.
- **Seersucker:** layered seersucker suiting at Thom Browne<sup>[3]</sup>.
- **Leather:** camel at Dior, beige suits at Saint Laurent, brown leather Bermudas at Sonia Carrasco and leather tracksuits at Givenchy; leather is becoming "more malleable", with "flexibility, fluidity, lightness, almost like butter", according to Alice Feillard of Galeries Lafayette<sup>[2]</sup>. Milan used woven and perforated leather for breathability<sup>[3]</sup>.
- **Tailoring cloth:** fine, lightweight wools blended with viscose, silk or linen; heavier double crepes with a dry, cool hand<sup>[4]</sup>.
- **Travel fabrics:** crease-proof stretch wool and technical materials at Herno<sup>[5]</sup>.

sections.heading: Fabric by fabric
sections.body:
| Fabric | Construction and hand | Best uses | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sheer cotton and silk voile | Very light, open | Shirts, layering | Rising |
| Satin (silk or synthetic) | Satin weave, fluid | Shirts, sets, trousers | Rising |
| Seersucker | Puckered plain weave, cool | Suits, shirts, shorts | Rising |
| Lightweight wool blends | Fine worsted with silk or linen | Summer suits | Core |
| Soft and perforated leather | Supple, breathable | Blousons, Bermudas, suits | Rising |
| Linen | Firm, cool | Shirts, suits, trousers | Core |
| Stretch and crease-proof wool | Technical worsted | Travel tailoring | Rising |

timing: In stores February to July 2027. Soft leather and seersucker continue into SS28 (Forecut assessment).
products: - Sheer shirts, satin shirts and sets, seersucker suits, leather blousons and shorts, linen and travel suits.
design_implications:
- Sheer shirts need French seams and clean facings.
- Test leather for colour fastness and perforation strength.
- Choose crease-recovery finishes for travel suits.
commercial_implications:
- Leather at premium; seersucker and linen at mid; satin across tiers depending on fibre.
- State fibre content clearly on satins.
